title: Horizontal Asymptote of Exponential
text: For the exponential function $f(x) = a \cdot b^x + q$, the horizontal asymptote is at $y = q$.\n\nThis is because as $x \to \infty$ or $x \to -\infty$, the function approaches $q$.

title: Determine q
text: Since the horizontal asymptote is at $y = -2$, we have:\n$$q = -2$$
